title: preview publish-plan job payload

pipelineVersionId.description: The draft to publish, or the superseded version a rollback re-publishes.

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of a preview job of kind publish-plan (engine design §12.1, §12.2): the re-processing plan and forecast of publishing (or rolling back to) the pipeline version. P1: every live document of the affected sources. Dedup plan:{pipelineId}.
